accountId.description: A 12-digit number, such as 123456789012, that uniquely identifies an AWS account

externalId.description: It can be passed to the AssumeRole API of the STS. It can be used in the condition element in a role's trust policy, allowing the role to be assumed only when a certain value is present in the external ID

v1AwsPartition.description: AWS accounts are scoped to a single partition. Allowed values [aws, aws-us-gov], Default values
